title: Case Lifecycle
prompt:
Process the following fictional case lifecycle events in order. If a transition is not permitted in the current state, skip it with no side effect.

Initial state:
C1 pending owner=A reviewed=false
C2 active owner=B reviewed=true
C3 held owner=C reviewed=true
C4 closed owner=A reviewed=true
C5 active owner=C reviewed=false
C6 pending owner=B reviewed=false

Transition rules:
- approve(C): only from pending; status=active and reviewed=true.
- hold(C): only from active; status=held.
- resume(C): only from held; status=active.
- transfer(C,owner): only from active or held; replace owner.
- close(C): only when status=active and reviewed=true; status=closed.
- reopen(C): only from closed; status=active and reviewed=false.
- review(C): only from active or held; reviewed=true.

Events:
E1 approve(C1)
E2 hold(C2)
E3 close(C2)
E4 resume(C3)
E5 transfer(C3,A)
E6 reopen(C4)
E7 close(C4)
E8 review(C4)
E9 close(C4)
E10 close(C5)

Return one JSON object with this shape:
{"result":{"events":[{"id":"E1","status":"applied"}, ...],"final_state":{"C1":{"status":"active","owner":"A","reviewed":true}, ...}}}
Include E1-E10 in order and exactly records C1-C6 in final_state.
